subject: International equipment delivery + cowork space expansion — Q4 plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Kim <sophie.kim@globaltechlogistics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: International equipment delivery + cowork space expansion — Q4 plan

Hi Sophie —

Following up from our call last week. We're finalizing plans for two items we want GlobalTech to handle for Redwood in Q4:

1) International laptop shipments to three APAC offices (SG, HK, SYD) — estimated 120 units total. Key constraints: door-to-door DDP, insured transit, and customs clearance.

2) Cowork space seat expansion in EMEA (London/Amsterdam) for a short-term contract through March 2026 — we need 25 additional seats with flexible rollback in case headcount changes.

Can you please send over: 
- A consolidated quote that combines logistics + warehousing + seat procurement discounts (if applicable)
- Proposed lead times for consolidated shipments vs. direct-sends per office
- Any mandatory customs paperwork Redwood needs to provide (commercial invoices, certificates)

We have a tight timeline: procurement needs a signed SOW by 11/10 to meet payroll and new-hire start dates.

Thanks — appreciate a preliminary number/ballpark by EOD Thursday (11/6).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Workplace Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Sophie Kim <sophie.kim@globaltechlogistics.com>

Cc: procurement@globaltechlogistics.com
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:37:00 +0100
Subject: Re: International equipment delivery + cowork space expansion — Q4 plan

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear rundown. Attaching a preliminary quote (GTech_Quote_Q4.pdf) and a draft shipping manifest template so your ops team can populate serials/MBNs. A few clarifying Qs before we firm numbers: 

- For APAC deliveries, do you want a single consolidated shipment into a regional hub (we can hold & split) or direct-to-site? Consolidated saves ~$18/unit but adds 4–7 days.
- Do laptops need battery declarations or additional EHS paperwork for Australia? We saw mixed requirements depending on OEM battery spec.
- For cowork seats: are you signing a 3-month minimum per location or rolling monthly? Pricing improves at the 3-month commitment level.

Attachments: [Attachment: GTech_Quote_Q4.pdf (PDF, 412 KB)], [Attachment: shipping_manifest_template.xlsx (XLSX, 48 KB)]

I'll mark options in the quote for consolidated vs direct and include an insurance supplement for DDP coverage. We can also add a temporary storage SKU if new hires are onboarding staggered.

If you want, I can book a 30-min call with our ops lead to walk through customs docs and timelines.

Cheers,
Sophie Kim
Senior Account Manager — GlobalTech Logistics
Sophie.Kim@globaltechlogistics.com

Forwarding Sophie's quote and manifest. Key points: 
- Quote includes a consolidated-shipping option that saves roughly $2.1k overall but pushes delivery by 5 business days.
- GTech will handle customs clearance and requires a high-level commercial invoice and Redwood EIN for DDP.
- Cowork expansion pricing shows a 10% delta between monthly rolling and 3-month commitment.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_SOW_cowork_extension.docx (DOCX, 94 KB)], [Attachment: shipping_manifest_draft.xlsx (XLSX, 62 KB)], [Attachment: GTech_Quote_Q4.pdf (PDF, 412 KB)]

Can procurement approve the vendor and SOW so I can route to Legal for a standard PO + DocuSign? Budget code is WP-OPS-Q4-2025. If we want to avoid the 5-day delay we should choose direct-to-site but be prepared for ~12% higher freight spend.

Also flag: Sophie included a DocuSign link for expedited signature if we confirm today: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-GT-LTL

Would appreciate quick eyes — I need to lock the lead times by end of day to meet 11/10 sign date.

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Workplace Operations

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 22:04:00 +0000

Marissa —

Reviewed. Approve GlobalTech as vendor for both services with the following commercial caveats: 
- Payment on Net-30 from invoice receipt (we will not accept Net-60).
- Add clause for partial refunds if cowork seats are canceled with >30 days notice.
- Confirm insurance / cargo value — we need full value replacement cover.

If Sophie can amend the SOW to reflect Net-30 and the cancellation refund terms, I’m good to sign and route via DocuSign. Please ask Legal to add our standard data handling appendix for the cowork sites (limited access logs only).
